kernel_specification.scaling_derived_or_.reason: The paper sketches how gamma²=k_max/(2c) turns the Gaussian edge envelope into exp(-c k_max/2), producing logarithmic bandwidth and hence logarithmic selector-query scaling. implementation_framework_preserved.block.reason: A_H and A_L are explicitly constructed using controlled rotations and increment/decrement circuits inside U_BE.
